_doc: QA approval gate for tools/import-evidence.js. Only Stirner-approved evidence ships in the app.
source: the frozen evidence.md snapshot the importer reads. The live /workspace/carlsen/evidence.md is NEVER read, so later edits cannot leak in.

Per topic: "snapshot" = that topic's text (incl. its One-line answer) from `source`; "round1" = frozen round-one text from evidence-approved/round1-v1-evidence.json; "pending" = a marked '[Pending QA approval]' placeholder. Topics missing from this list are pending.

T6 SWITCH: topics.6 can be set to "round1" (v1 round-one text) or "snapshot". 19:00 EET Hoang decided: T6 Why? text from the approved snapshot; the app's rest prescription stays 2-3 min with a 2:30 default timer on every exercise (data.js), presented as the app's default inside T6's approved 90 s-3 min range (settings.convention.rest-default).

fallbackToApprovedTopic: when a UI key's primary topic is pending, use the next topic in that key's list if it is approved (only listed where that topic already states the same rule). false = strict placeholders.
Flip a value and re-run: sh tools/build.sh
exerciseNotes: show exercises.json `evidenceNote` text in the app (Stirner approved exercises.json round 2: 119 exercises, 20 notes).
